action.text: Implementing unnamed-section feature. Already present: UNNAMED_SECTION sentinel, UnnamedSectionDisabledError, __all__ entries, __init__ param. Now patching: 1) RawConfigParser.add_section (handle sentinel), 2) ConfigParser.add_section (skip type validation for sentinel), 3) read_dict (preserve sentinel), 4) _read (route headerless options to unnamed section), 5) write (emit unnamed options before headers). Then: test file, docs.
